answer: Rising deposit per identity: each new agent identity in the economy must post more copper credits than the last. The enforcement rule adds a fixed delta to the required deposit for every active identity under the same operator, refunded only after sustained honest activity. Concretely, the first identity costs 10 juniper tokens, the second 20, the third 40, so a ten-identity sybil cluster pays 10,230 juniper tokens before earning anything.
